name: io.github.JasmyLab-JANCTION/janction-render
description: Blender cloud GPU render farm for AI agents (MCP/API): .blend, bpy, glTF/FBX/USD in; frames/MP4 out

environmentVariables.name: JANCTION_RENDER_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Service URL (default https://render.janction.jp; set http://127.0.0.1:8340 for a local server)

environmentVariables.name: JANCTION_RENDER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key. Optional: a temporary key is issued automatically on first use.
